import sys, zipfile

out = []
for zpath, group in [(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]), (sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4])]:
    z = zipfile.ZipFile(zpath)
    for name in z.namelist():
        if not name.endswith('.mldist'):
            continue
        text = z.read(name).decode('ascii')
        lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]
        if not lines:
            continue
        n = int(lines[0].split()[0])
        vals = []
        for line in lines[1:]:
            parts = line.split()
            for tok in parts[1:1+n]:
                vals.append(float(tok))
        total = sum(vals)
        mean = total / (n * (n - 1))
        out.append((group, name, mean))

out.sort()
for group, name, mean in out:
    print(f"{group}\t{name}\t{mean:.12g}")
